skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, concepts, roles of financial investment, financial system, and movement of cash flow in investment.
Understand different types of assets, securities, financial markets, and their roles for businesses and financial organizations.
Differentiate between various types of risks, relationship between returns and risks, and significance of risk diversification.
Understand the process of building investment portfolios, correlation between securities, and application of modern portfolio theory.
Understand the operation and trading methods of specific financial instruments, basic investment strategies, and apply them in practice.
Understand the cost of capital in investments, valuation methods, and evaluation of investment performance.
Understand the role of information and its relation to stock price movements using Efficient Market Hypothesis and Random Walk Theory.
Apply knowledge and theories to solve investment problems.
Analyze market situations and practical investment scenarios, and apply learned knowledge to build and manage effective investment portfolios.
Develop self-study skills, independent work, teamwork, accumulate experience to continue higher studies, and have awareness about ethics and legal compliance in investment activities.
